notes: DONE 2026-11-02. E3 shipped the --variant module:factory path, but no real variant existed to load, so the only proof was an inline class inside a unit test. This ticket adds scripts/eval/variants/route_lighter.py: a sample variant that changes exactly one decision (content_analysis routes to the lighter deepseek-v4-flash instead of MiMo, the same way POLISH/MOCK_GEN already do) and is never imported by production code, so it cannot change a default. Running `python scripts/eval/run_gate.py --skip-benchmarks --variant scripts.eval.variants.route_lighter:make_policy` now proves the whole chain end to end: injection by name, policy/variant snapshots, and a diff whose only category is models while the gate stays red=False. Two tests pin it: the loaded variant differs from the baseline only in models (with content_analysis asserted specifically), and the CLI injects the real module and prints 'decisions changed: models' / 'mode=gate red=False'. Documentation truth was also stale: the plan header still said only E1/E2 delivered and the architecture doc still called roadmap item 10 'dependency / not started', although E1 (5cd), E2 (5ce) and E3 (5cf) were shipped; the header now lists E1/E2/E3, a new §6.8 documents the variant example and the three still-open E4 items (LLM-judge allowance, budget, account authorisation), and §9's roadmap row plus the conclusion now say 'in progress' with the ticket ids. Verification: test_eval_gate.py 15 passed; docs/claim gates and full suite in the journal; ruff green.
